SOAK: EVAL DONE 2026-07-22 (gate rewritten same day, see [[project.soakPolicy]]). Window 2026-06-17..23 UTC on the gate machine: 9 calls / 1 active day / 1 project / 0 namespaces written — categorical fail on every criterion; the earlier '~451 init writes in window' leak estimate was WRONG (actual: 1; the floods were May 7-9 + Jun 10). Work machine same window (context only, not gate): 72 calls / 3 days / 4 projects / 4 namespaces — real organic signal, still sub-gate. VERDICT per policy: thin signal at cap → ship the SMALLEST scoped theme, carry candidates forward, do not extend. Cross-machine dataset analysis that informed this: [[context.crossMachineDataset]] (7 findings → issues #137-#143 filed 2026-07-22).

CARRY FORWARD to later Trust/Find cycles: #84 #42 #45 #135 #136 #137 #138 #139 #140. Rationale: this very eval was distorted by exactly these measurement gaps; fixing the record first makes the next soak's data trustworthy.
